Class RepairVehicle

java.lang.Object
vehicles.Vehicle
vehicles.RepairVehicle
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class RepairVehicle extends Vehicle
Represents a vehicle brought to a CarDealership for repair.

Extends Vehicle with repair-specific attributes: damage description, number plate, repair status, and priority level (where 1 is the highest priority and 3 is the lowest).

Author:
Juan Carlos Alfaro Jiménez
